feature-implementation.description: Implement the oldest open GitHub issue end-to-end: branch → code → PR → review → merge
feature-implementation.template:
Run the feature-implementation workflow.

Load the skill: @.claude/skills/feature-implementation/SKILL.md

Then execute every step as documented:
1. Check open issues (exclude epics)
2. If no issues → invoke compliance-feature workflow first
3. Analyze + prioritize issues
4. Plan implementation (BE-first)
5. Implement on feature branch + open PR
6. Run code-review-local skill
7. Fix Critical/High findings (max 3 iterations)
8. Merge via release-manager agent

compliance-feature.description: Run full compliance workflow: scan Italian regulations, gap analysis, competitor research, create GitHub issue backlog
compliance-feature.template:
Run the compliance-feature workflow.

Load the skill: @.claude/skills/compliance-feature/SKILL.md

Then execute every step as documented:
1. Check if product roadmap + epics exist
2. If missing → run Refinement Meeting (product-owner + architect + scrum-master-casazen, in-memory)
3. regulatory-agent: scan 8 regulatory topics, update .claude/context/regulations/
4. analyzer-agent: gap analysis vs codebase (MISSING/PARTIAL/OUTDATED/COMPLIANT)
5. Competitive research: Lodgify, Guesty, Hostaway
6. scrum-master-casazen: create GitHub issues (max 10, CRITICAL first, linked to epics)

contract-audit.description: Audit FE/BE API contract alignment and create GitHub issues for misalignments
contract-audit.template:
Run the contract-audit workflow.

Load the skill: @.claude/skills/contract-audit/SKILL.md

Then execute every step as documented:
1. Read backend controllers + DTOs in parallel with frontend types + API client
2. Gap analysis across 4 categories: TypeScript Types, API Client, Query Hooks, Documentation
3. Create 1 GitHub Issue per gap (github-agent)
4. Create 1 summary issue on backend
5. Report totals by category and severity

Audit only — no code changes.

code-review.description: Review current PR changes following CasaZen quality standards
code-review.template:
Run a code review on the current changes.

Load the skill: @.claude/skills/code-review-local/SKILL.md

Review the current git diff against:
- REVIEW.md (review-specific rules)
- .claude/rules/security.md (security guardrails)
- .claude/rules/code-style.md (async + testing standards)
- .claude/rules/compliance.md (Italian regulatory checks)

Output findings by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with file:line references.

context.description: Show current project status: regulatory update date, roadmap status, open issue count
context.template:
!`bash .claude/hooks/scripts/session-context.sh 2>/dev/null || echo 'Tech: .NET 10 / EF Core / SQL Server — run /compliance-feature (plan) or /feature-implementation (implement)'`
